rulings.reason: In the executed facts, the headings are opposed at t=0 ([1,0] vs [-1,0]), so a is not behind b at any observation before t=1000. The body's SINCE accepts a behind b at the recognition observation itself as the witness, but the contract requires that witness at an earlier observation. The unknown clause does not apply either, because the headings were not aligned since the recording began, so the contract's verdict is fails.
rulings.quote: provided that a was behind b (drv.position.behind of a relative to b) at an earlier observation and the headings stayed aligned (rel.same_direction with the alignment tolerance) at every observation from that one to the recognition
